about: High or critical npm advisories that CI accepts for now (scripts/audit-check.mjs). Each needs a reason and a review date; after that date CI fails until the entry is fixed, renewed or removed.

advisories.reason: Memory exhaustion on oversized constrained collections. The fix needs zod 4 (breaking API changes); that upgrade is the next planned security build.
